Definition: Merajoth, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Meraioth is the name of two priests in the line of Aaron, one in the early genealogy and one in Ezra's own line. 1 Chronicles 6:6 names Meraioth the son of Zerahiah, and Ezra 7:3 names Meraioth the son of Azariah in Ezra's descent. Nehemiah 11:11 names him again among the fathers of Seraiah, the ruler of the house of God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the priestly line is kept name by name because the priesthood itself was kept that way, one faithful father at a time.
